notes.content:

- Slightly reduced health on some enemies but increased aggressiveness
- Added a skip button to all the training dummy fights
- Gave starting enemy a helmet

notes.title: Keyboard Update!
notes.content:
- Keyboard controls have been significantly improved to feel snappier and easier to control.
- Super Dummy received a few new animations upon taking damage
- Slightly slowed attacks of Goblin, Knight and Death whose attacks could be tricky to react to in time.
- Slightly reduced overwhelmingly large shield of Destroyer form of Death.

notes.title: Very first patch!
notes.content:
Thank you to all who reported the continue button bug! The bug should be patched up now along with a few UI improvements.

- Fixed bug where clicking the continue button after defeating the water elemental would cause you to replay the level
- Fancier healthbar!
- Game now starts in wide version
- Slight adjustments to early game tutorial pacing
